overview: Mauritius is an island country in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar. Its capital and largest city is Port Louis. The islands had no people until European settlement, and Mauritius became independent from the United Kingdom in 1968; it has since become one of Africa's most stable and prosperous countries. It was the only home of the dodo, which died out in the 1600s.

geography.text: The main island of Mauritius is volcanic, with a central plateau surrounded by mountains and a coast almost completely ringed by coral reefs. The country also includes the island of Rodrigues and several smaller, more remote islands.

history.text: Mauritius was uninhabited until the Dutch settled it in 1638; the dodo was extinct within a century. France took it in 1715 and brought enslaved Africans to work on sugar plantations. Britain captured it in 1810 and, after slavery ended, brought workers from India. Mauritius became independent in 1968 and is now one of Africa's richest democracies.

government.text: Mauritius is a parliamentary republic and one of Africa's strongest democracies. Parliament elects the President, and the Prime Minister leads the government. Elections have been free and fair since independence in 1968.

economy.text: Mauritius has one of the highest incomes per person in Africa. It moved from sugar to textiles, tourism and financial services. In 2025 Britain agreed to hand over the Chagos Islands to Mauritius.

culture.text: Most Mauritians have roots in India, while others descend from Africans, Europeans and Chinese. Mauritian Creole is the common language. Sega, a dance and music style, is listed by UNESCO. The dodo lived only on Mauritius.

sport.text: Football and horse racing are popular; the Champ de Mars in Port Louis is one of the oldest racecourses in the southern hemisphere. Boxer Bruno Julie won Mauritius's first Olympic medal in 2008.

didYouKnow: The dodo lived only on Mauritius and died out in the 1600s.
Mauritius's Champ de Mars, opened in 1812, is one of the oldest racecourses in the southern hemisphere.
